name: Ignition Key
summary: At Sludge Fen, Wizzlecrank waits for the Ignition Key to free a stolen shredder.

sections.title: A Missing Piece of Espionage
sections.body:
Wizzlecrank, Sputtervalve of Ratchet's operative, waits inside a Venture Company shredder at Sludge Fen. Sent to steal the machine, he found its movement column locked. So he feigned mechanical trouble while the foremen watched, hoping someone would fetch the Ignition Key.

Supervisor Lugwizzle keeps the key atop the central oil derrick. It unlocks the shredder's movement column and gives Wizzlecrank control of its arm, speed, and rotation.

faq.q: Where can the Ignition Key be found?
faq.answer: Supervisor Lugwizzle keeps the Ignition Key in the control room atop the oil derrick at Sludge Fen, where he oversees the drilling work.

faq.q: Why does Wizzlecrank need this specific key?
faq.answer: The advanced Venture Company shredder has a locked movement column. Without the key, Wizzlecrank cannot control its rotation, speed, stability, or arm well enough to drive it away.
Sputtervalve, a goblin engineer in Ratchet, arranged the theft to obtain the Venture Company's superior engineering designs.

faq.q: What happens once the key is delivered?
faq.answer: With the key, Wizzlecrank unlocks the movement column and starts the shredder's engine. Then he must race through Sludge Fen's hostile laborers to escape toward Ratchet.

angles.text: The Ignition Key unlocks a shredder with advanced controls. Its speed regulation and fine arm movement outclass typical goblin designs.
